description: Generate a static QR code as SVG, offline, with no account. The link or text is stored inside the code itself, so it keeps working for as long as the link does, but it cannot be changed after printing. Use create_dynamic_qr_code instead when the destination may change or scans must be counted.

error_correction.description: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30% of the code can be damaged.

foreground.description: Hex colour of the modules, e.g. #000000. Keep it dark on a light background.

output_path.description: Absolute path of a new .svg file to write (an existing file is never overwritten). When omitted, the SVG is returned as text.

size.description: Width and height of the SVG in pixels (default 512).

name: generate_qr_code
title: Generate a static QR code
